## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline  
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size = 6 anchor days; selection method = J's source-of-truth trade days (immutable); overfit risk = high if engine tuned to these days only  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet computed)  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA fill simulation not yet run)  
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day unknown; max drawdown unknown; blow-up scenario = engine taking large losses on loser days  
6. **Concentration:** Unknown; requires aggregation of P&L across all days to compute top-5 concentration  

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators must pass (all tests in `backtest/tests/`).  
- Walk-forward analysis must show OOS Sharpe > 0 and WF ratio >= 0.70.  
- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days must show simulated vs real P&L diff < ±20%.  
- Anchor no-regression: engine must take all 3 winner days and skip/lose less on loser days.
